ops.whyShort: Horde 4494 needs 7732, and 7732 is the Zukk'ash carapace report. 4496 and the hive queen sit behind it.
ops.original: Do not accept March of the Silithid in Azshara or turn it in at Gadgetzan. Do not take Bungle in the Jungle.

ops.whyShort: Seven of each crystal color is a collection sink, and it is what opens the three pylon runs.
ops.original: Skip Crystals of Power. Do not accept the Northern, Eastern, or Western Pylon, or Making Sense of It.

ops.whyShort: Lost! only leads to the Ringo escort back to Marshal's Refuge.
ops.original: Skip Lost! and do not lead Ringo out of the volcano cave.

ops.whyShort: The moonwell sample exists to start the corrupted-saber escort.
ops.original: Skip Well of Corruption and do not take Winna's kitten to the moonwell.

ops.whyShort: Fifteen Blood Ambers are the plant-salve loop along the Felwood road.
ops.original: Skip Cleansing Felwood. Do not plant-salve corrupted flowers for Maybess.

sources.label: QuestieDB 4102 objective item 11503, 15 Blood Amber, no next

ops.whyShort: Thirty owlbeasts is its own camp, and the follow-up is another owl count in Winterspring.
ops.original: Skip Wild Guardians. Do not take the Winterspring follow-up.

sources.label: QuestieDB 4521 creatures 15 and 15, next 4741, end npc 10306 at 34.73, 52.79

ops.whyShort: The yeti chain goes from ten thick furs to two pristine horns and then a mechanical-chicken delivery.
ops.original: Skip both Are We There, Yeti? quests. Do not take the third step to the goblin towns.

ops.whyShort: Eight uncracked horns are a chimera drop farm, and the next step flies back to Burning Steppes.
ops.original: Turn in Felnok Steelspring and decline Chillwind Horns. Do not return the horns to Tinkee.

ops.whyShort: The modeled yeti and owlbeast grinds are a long camp. Ursius, Brumeran, and the Winterfall kills already use those mobs.
ops.original: Do not grind Ice Thistle yeti to 55 or crazed owlbeasts to 56 as their own steps.

sources.label: OpenXP 54-55 Winterspring quest ids 3783, 6603, 980, 4842, 5082, no separate grind step
QuestieDB 5054 and 5055 are single named kills; 5082 is Winterfall kill counts

ops.whyShort: Four Frostmaul Shards are a cave farm on the way out of Hyjal, and the cache follow-up stays in Everlook only after that farm.
ops.original: Skip Luck Be With You. Do not detour through Everlook after Hyjal for the shards.

sources.label: QuestieDB 969 item 12334, next 975, end npc 10307 at 61.92, 38.3

ops.whyShort: The Quel'Lithien lodge is 8 rangers, 8 pathstriders, and 8 woodsmen plus the registry, off the Tirion road.
ops.original: Skip The Ranger Lord's Behest. Do not fly back to Light's Hope for that lodge.

sources.label: QuestieDB 6133 creatures 8565, 8564, 8563 and item 15847, no pre

ops.whyShort: Finding A-Me is the ape cave you are already in. The follow-up is a mithril casing and then an escort.
ops.original: Turn in Chasing A-Me 01 at the robot and do not accept the casing or the escort.

ops.whyShort: The nests finish beside the raptors. The bait quest is a separate devilsaur kill.
ops.original: Turn in The Scent of Lar'korwi and do not accept The Bait for Lar'korwi.

ops.whyShort: The bloodpetal counts finish around the east camp. The follow-up leaves for Marvon's workshop.
ops.original: Turn in Larion and Muigin and do not accept Marvon's Workshop.

ops.whyShort: 4726 is already turned in in Burning Steppes. The Everlook hand-in is a talk.
ops.original: Turn in Felnok Steelspring at 61.63, 38.61 and decline the horn quest.

sources.label: QuestieDB 4808 pre 4726, end npc 10468 spawn 61.63, 38.61, map zone 618

ops.whyShort: The firewater drops while killing Winterfall for 5082. The follow-up sends the player back to a Felwood cauldron.
ops.original: Turn in Winterfall Firewater at Donova and do not accept Falling to Corruption.

ops.whyShort: Ursius and Brumeran are one named each on the loop. Shy-Rotam is a later cave elite.
ops.original: Turn in Brumeran of the Chillwind and do not accept Shy-Rotam.

ops.whyShort: The canteen fills at the Jaedenar moonwell the player is already visiting. The follow-up leaves the zone.
ops.original: Turn in Collection of the Corrupt Water at Bloodvenom and do not accept Seeking Spiritual Aid.

ops.whyShort: The first Timbermaw kills finish at Grazle on the south road. The next step is another hold trip, and the route flies to Everlook from Bloodvenom.
ops.original: Turn in Timbermaw Ally at Grazle (50.93, 85.01) and do not accept Speak to Nafien.

ops.whyShort: Eight diseased wolves sit on the cauldron road. The follow-up is a second wildlife lap.
ops.original: Turn in The Wildlife Suffers Too at Mulgris and do not accept the bear follow-up.

ops.whyShort: One Scholomance clear can use the quest 5098 offers. It is not a scripted run.
ops.original: Optional: one Scholomance clear if a group is already forming. Do not write the instance steps. 838 stays a tip.

ops.whyShort: Stratholme is the same kind of stop as Scholomance: one clear, not a quest script.
ops.original: Optional: one Stratholme clear if a group is already forming. Stay on the open-world road otherwise.

sources.label: QuestieDB zone 139 Eastern Plaguelands uiMapId 1423; the route step has no quest id

ops.whyShort: The mangled journal drops from crater mobs the player is already killing and turns in at Marshal's Refuge.
ops.original: When A Mangled Journal drops, accept Williden's Journal.
ops.text: Accept Williden's Journal from item 11116 if it drops while killing for the carcass, the bones, and the pterrordax.

ops.whyShort: Williden stands in the same refuge turn-in as Expedition Salvation.
ops.original: Turn Williden's Journal in to Williden Marshal with the other refuge quests.
ops.text: Turn in Williden's Journal to Williden Marshal.

ops.whyShort: 5233 ends at the cauldron. The filled bottle is a return, the same pattern as Felstone and Dalson's Tears. Do not continue to Gahrron's Wither.
ops.original: Accept Return to the Bulwark from the Writhing Haunt cauldron, then stop the cauldron chain.
ops.text: Accept Return to the Bulwark from the Scourge Cauldron at the Writhing Haunt.

sources.label: QuestieDB object 176393 starts 5234, spawn 53.02, 65.61, zone 28, uiMapId 1422; 5234 pre 5233 next 5235

ops.whyShort: Vandis is the same Bulwark turn-in already used for the first two bottles.
ops.original: Turn the Writhing Haunt bottle in to Shadow Priestess Vandis. Do not accept Target: Gahrron's Wither.
ops.text: Turn in Return to the Bulwark to Shadow Priestess Vandis.

ops.whyShort: 6030 is accepted in Everlook and has no prerequisite. The first Eastern Plaguelands stop is already Light's Hope.
ops.original: Turn Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in at Light's Hope before riding to Tirion.
ops.text: Turn in Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

sources.label: QuestieDB 6030 no pre, end npc 11039 spawn 71.63, 50.09, zone 139, uiMapId 1423
